Looping in a couple operational points so we can come prepared. Quick calls-out:

- Dedicated vs Hosted: Dedicated gives predictability for sustained throughput, but lead time is ~3 weeks to stand up a small pool and validate PCI/KMS integration if they opt for on-prem keys. Hosted trial with a temporary quota bump is usually the fastest way to start the POC.
- Hosted trial quota bump: we can request a temporary increase to 10M tokens/day for up to two weeks; typical turnaround 24-48 hours once we have the HubSpot deal + contact.
- What we need from Acme: expected peak qps, representative prompt set (CSV), and a service account for test ingestion (or API key scoped to a test org).

Action owners I've assigned: 
- Marissa: coordinate quota bump and HubSpot paperwork (ACME-POC-2027-04)
- Ben: lead the load test script and monitor token burn + latency
- Diego: validate staging pool configuration and run the 50 rps bursts during the rehearsal

Added HubSpot record and drive folder to related links. I'll start the quota request template once Jordan confirms the rehearsal slot.
